confidence_notes: Restaurant, coffee and draft-beer anchors use Xi'an citywide cost-of-living estimates from June–October 2026. Cocktail and wine are estimated at roughly 4.8× and 4.2× the local draft-beer price because comparable citywide aggregates are weak; lodging estimates are holistic and less certain.
comparable_city_reasoning: Xi'an's own citywide restaurant data anchor food and drink. Lodging estimates reflect lower-cost domestic visitor accommodation in inland Chinese tourism cities.
